use_l1loss_for_stereo_flow: use L1Loss to compute mean absolute error between predictions and ground truth for stereo or flow tasks
use_laplacianloss_with_confidence: use LaplacianLoss to compute a confidence-weighted loss for CroCo-Stereo on ETH3D datasets
use_laplacianlossbounded_for_flow: use LaplacianLossBounded to compute a bounded confidence-weighted loss for CroCo-Flow tasks
compute_stereo_metrics_batch: use StereoMetrics to compute avgerr, rmse, and bad pixel thresholds for a stereo batch
aggregate_flow_dataset_metrics: use FlowDatasetMetrics to aggregate L1 error, EPE, and speed-binned metrics across flow dataset batches
